name: metrics.query
title: Query a measure
description: Reads a named measure of the books (revenue, gross profit, net burn, cash, receivables, a KPI and others) from the semantic layer, as the person asking may see it. Returns typed facts: each has an ID, the value as exact decimal text, its unit and currency, the period, the dimension member, the ledger revision and a lineage link. Quote figures only from facts; cite each by its ID. Use by to split a measure by account, customer, vendor, department or project, and grain month for one fact a month. A project's approved time is the measure project_minutes, by project: hours only, never a rate or a cost.

measure.description: A measure of the semantic layer.

by.description: The dimension to split it by, which the measure must offer.

member.description: Keep one member of the dimension: its ID (an account's code too).

from.description: The first month, YYYY-MM; left out, the last month's.

to.description: The last month, YYYY-MM; left out, the month of the organisation's today.

grain.description: month: a fact a month; total: one over the months, a flow summed, a stock at the last month's end.

revision.description: Read the ledger as at this revision; 0 or left out, as it stands.
